name: Maid to Maze ~Anata no Soba ni~
original_name: メイドトゥメイズ～あなたのそばに～
source:
This country is full of dungeons. Main character is a prince how is suddenly announced that in a year he will need to inherit this kingdom. In order to gain public support he sets off to exploring a dungeon, but appears to be too weak for the task. In order not to look weak he asks a maid who is superior to warriors to accompany him on this task as a bride candidate.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-august-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这个国家充满了地牢。主角是一位王子，他突然宣布一年后他需要继承这个王国。为了获得公众的支持，他开始探索地牢，但他似乎太弱了，无法完成这项任务。为了不显得软弱，他请了一位比武士更优秀的女仆作为新娘候选人陪他完成这项任务。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-august-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
